'''Da Ruan''' ({{lang-zh|s=阮达}}; September 10, 1960 – July 31, 2011) was a Chinese-Belgian mathematician, scientist, professor. He had a Ph.D. from [[Ghent University]].<ref>{{cite journal|title=Obituary: Da Ruan (10 September 1960 to 31 July 2011)|journal=International Journal of General Systems|volume=40|issue=8|pages=775–776|doi=10.1080/03081079.2011.625631|year=2011|last1=Li|first1=Tianrui}}</ref>
